answer: Locks are entered in horizon, expire in marble, and signal lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Anyone running 76 aliases thus needs 113 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1640 identities would post 797 proofs and burn roughly 44 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
